title: Palace: Marcos had no hand in P50-M bounty for Bato dela Rosa

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Malacañang distanced President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday from the P50-million bounty for the arrest of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, saying the reward was ordered solely by Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla and the Philippine National Police leadership.
